name: Annotations UI
description: User interface for annotation management: annotate landing/add/edit pages, bulk delete, and annotation revision history with optional diff comparison.

suggests.drupal/diff: Adds a 'Compare with previous' link to annotation revision history

project_description: Annotations UI is the core management interface for the Annotations suite. It provides the annotate landing page listing opted-in targets, per-target add/edit pages, the annotation edit and delete forms, bulk delete-all, and an annotation revision history controller that adds diff comparison links when the diff module is installed.
